app.name: SentinelDesk
login.subtitle: Sign in to access your remote desktop
login.locked: Too many failed attempts — try again later
toolbar.mic: Send your microphone to the desktop — right-click to pick which one
toolbar.files: Files — transfer to and from the desktop
toolbar.quality: Stream quality — auto, high or medium
quality.needControl: Only whoever has control can change the stream quality
toolbar.shot: Save a picture of the screen to your machine
toolbar.rec: Record the screen to your machine
capture.recStarted: Recording… it will be saved on your machine
capture.noStream: There is nothing to capture yet
capture.unsupported: This browser cannot record the stream
room.freeNotice: The controls are free — nobody is driving.
room.freeHint: Take the controls — nobody is using them
room.pauseTitle: Hold the agent where it is — its work is suspended, not lost
notice.credential:
A credential was visible to the AI on this desktop: {kinds}.

It has already been sent to the model provider as part of this session and cannot be taken back. Rotate it as soon as you can.

SentinelDesk cannot protect a secret it is shown — only ones held in the vault and used by reference stay out of the model entirely.
notice.kind.url_password: a password inside a connection URL
notice.kind.config_password: a password in a configuration value
room.abortTitle: Stop what the agent is doing and take the controls
room.watching: You are watching — press “Take control” to interact
media.needControl: Only whoever has control can publish audio or video
media.noSlot: The server did not offer a slot for that track
media.micOn: Microphone is now a capture device on the desktop
drop.title: Drop to copy to the desktop
drop.needControl: Putting files on the desktop needs the controls — take them first
fm.title: File Manager
fm.subtitle: remote desktop ↔ your machine
fm.dropHere: Drop files here to send them to the desktop.
fm.pickFolderHint: to browse it side by side
fm.errTicket: could not request the download ticket
fm.dirNoChannel: Folders cannot be downloaded whole — open it and take the files
toolbar.hidden: Toolbar hidden — press º to bring it back
ask.title: Control request
ask.body: {who} is asking for control of the desktop, so it can move the mouse and type. You can take it back at any time.
toolbar.rtmp: Send this desktop to YouTube, Twitch, Facebook, or a player of your own
rs.title: Live streaming
rs.subtitle: this desktop, sent somewhere else
rs.keyPlaceholder: paste the key from the platform
rs.hintCustom: Point VLC or OBS at this machine. From Docker the host is host.docker.internal. Use udp:// for VLC — it only speaks srt:// as a caller, so it cannot receive one. srt:// is for a receiver that listens.
rs.hintPlatform: Only the key. The ingest address is already known.
rs.keyframesNote: Off, the picture stays sharper: keyframes are large and the bits they take come out of the detail. Platforms always get them.
rs.live: Live. Everyone in the room can see this.
rs.unavailable: This session encodes VP8, which no destination accepts. Restart with ENCODER=x264.
toolbar.help: Documentation — opens in a new tab
toolbar.voice: Voice with the other participants — the audio goes browser to browser, never through the server
toolbar.kb: Virtual keyboard — type from a tablet, with the keys touch keyboards lack
settings.micHint: Goes INTO the desktop — apps and recordings hear it.
settings.voiceHint: The conference among viewers — the desktop never hears it.
settings.denied: The browser refused the microphone — check the site permission.
settings.echoHint: Self-listen echoes on speakers; headphones are kinder.
settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Your name
settings.nameHint: Shown in the roster and on your pointer. Letters, digits, space, - and _.
kb.needControl: The keyboard needs the desktop controls — take control first
chat.title: Agent
chat.viewingPast: You are reading a past conversation.
chat.emptyTitle: Ask the agent to do something
chat.emptyHint: It drives the desktop on the left. Every tool it calls appears here as it happens.
chat.placeholderPast: Reading history — go back to the live conversation to type.
chat.working: Working — send another message to steer it.
chat.enterToSend: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.noModels: the agent has not said which models it has
chat.cmd.compact: fold the conversation into a summary
chat.cmd.connect: sign the agent in — opens the terminal, where the whole flow lives
chat.cmd.code: finish signing in — /code <the code the page gave you>
chat.cmd.stop: stop what the agent is doing
chat.cmd.key: store an API key — only from a terminal
chat.resize: Drag to resize · double-click to reset
chat.forgetAllWhy: {n} conversations will be removed from the agent's own record. This cannot be undone.
chat.forgetAllKeepsLive: The conversation you are in stays — the agent is still writing to it.
chat.forgetNeedsControl: Take the controls to delete history.
chat.forgetNeedsControlFrom: {who} has the controls. Deleting history needs them.
chat.gateUnconfigured: The agent has no model configured
ws.skillsWhy: Everything you can type with “/”. The same palette as the agent’s terminal, minus what the runtime refuses to accept from a browser.
ws.connectLocalTitle: Signing a provider in is a terminal flow.
ws.connectLocal: Typing /connect here opens the embedded console, where the whole flow runs — the link, the sign-in, the code. The key itself never travels through this page.
ws.agentFresh: The agent finished something while you were away
ws.keepTalking: Keep talking without leaving the desktop…
ws.rewindNote: Rewinding moves the conversation back before a task. The desktop is NOT rewound.
ws.loginSubtitle: Sign in to access your remote desktop.
ws.composerHint: The agent sees and drives this desktop. You can interrupt it whenever you want.
